UI_Options_Personality_Tooltip: Personality affects how often the character speaks and the style of their lines
UI_Options_Rule_Tooltip: Line usage rules: use only built-in lines, only extra lines, or mix both
UI_Options_Levels_Tooltip: Select which moodle levels trigger lines. Levels 2, 3, and 4 are enabled by default. Lines only trigger when worsening to the specified level, e.g., Hunger 0 → Hunger 1 won't trigger, but Hunger 2 → Hunger 1 will.
